parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The new description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new name of the snapshot-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), or colons (:).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SnapshotGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call [DescribeSnapshotGroups](~~210940~~) to query snapshot-consistent group IDs.
